page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a compute-optimized, GPU-accelerated instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz, providing 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores with two threads per core. The instance is configured with 752.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 5.88 GB per vCPU. Acceleration is handled by four bundled NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs, which supply a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, while local disk storage is not bundled, necessitating reliance on remote storage solutions for data persistence.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel throughput across compute and memory subsystems. In multi-threaded processing evaluations, the instance scored 123935.69 on stress-ng and reached 575.13 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, placing it in the upper tiers of multi-core compute performance. Single-core results are moderate, recording 1882.5 in stress-ng and 28.11 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression. Memory bandwidth remains high under load, sustaining 253.9 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 103.09 GB/sec on writes. Furthermore, memory-intensive serving workloads showed 100.72 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations and 61.52 GB/sec in static web throughput.

From an architectural perspective, the instance balances dense multi-GPU acceleration with high memory capacity and networking throughput. The absence of integrated local storage requires data pipelines to account for external volume I/O latency over the 64 Gbps network interface. Single-threaded metrics indicate that workloads reliant strictly on high single-core clocks will not fully exploit the platform. However, the combination of four NVIDIA A10 GPUs and 128 vCPUs delivers high efficiency for highly parallelized tasks. The instance is suited for multi-stream video processing, distributed AI inference, graphic workstation virtualization, and high-concurrency caching services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for compute-intensive and graphics-accelerated applications. Powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors clocked at 2.9 GHz, it supplies 128 dedicated vCPUs across 64 physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, alongside 752.0 GB of system memory. Graphics and hardware acceleration are provided by four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, though it includes no local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence. Benchmark results show strong multi-core processing capability, evidenced by 123935.69 in multi-core stress-ng tests and 575.13 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, alongside high memory read bandwidth reaching 253.9 GB/sec. This platform is suited for distributed AI inference, multi-stream video transcoding, 3D graphics rendering, and concurrent database tasks.
